acceptanceCriteria: On a fixture shaped like the Beamfall core repo, a hook event returns AGENTS.md/ADR authority results.
The setup requirement (index, authority config) is detected and reported by corvint doctor when missing.
Spec/requirement updated in the same change.
body: In beamfall-workspace/beamfall (Go modular monolith with AGENTS.md and ADRs), every observed hook event degraded with frontier-authority-unavailable and returned no authoritative results; latency p50 640 ms, p95 1447 ms; Codex events also report index-snapshot-stale windows. Corvint is paying latency and returning nothing usable on its main external adopter. Diagnose why project authority (AGENTS.md, docs/adr) is not resolved there, fix it or document the required setup, and add an external-repo qualification that fails when an adopter with governing docs gets zero authority. Relates to V1-0869 (frontier-authority noise). Evidence: `corvint observations` in ~/projects/beamfall-workspace/beamfall on 2026-10-19 (Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 668, Claude Code plugin corvint@corvint 0.3.1).
title: Beamfall core repository: 69/69 hook events return zero authoritative context (frontier-authority-unavailable), p95 1447 ms
